desc: Derive the interval/sign feasibility model and pairwise-conflict lemma.
Validate the lemma with brute-force/difference constraints on small cases.
Parse input and normalize people to `(idx,l,r,sign)`, preserving original order.
Compute endpoint conflicts via latest same-left and same-right conflicts with prefix maxima.
Implement compressed segment-tree monotonic-deque sliding window for same-sign crossing condition A.
Apply the crossing solver to original and reversed coordinates for each sign to cover both crossing orientations.
Combine endpoint and crossing prefix maxima into `minL[R]` and answer queries by `L >= minL[R]`.
Test on samples and small brute-force instances; optimize Python performance and memory.
